storefront.body: Pick a look, then place the product on the grid.

share.body: Paste the link in your bio, a message or your own site.

tourReplay.title: Guided tour
tourReplay.description: A short walk through the main thing to do on each page, one step at a time.

overviewNav.title: Find your way around
overviewNav.body: Everything in your store is one click away from the menu. This tour stops at the main thing to do on each page.
overviewNav.bodySidebar: Everything in your store is one click away in this sidebar. This tour stops at the main thing to do on each page.
overviewNav.bodyMenu: Everything in your store is behind this menu. This tour stops at the main thing to do on each page.

search.title: Search for anything
search.body: Search jumps straight to any page, product, order or setting.
search.bodyTopBar: Jump straight to any page, product, order or setting.
search.bodyPhone: Tap here to jump straight to any page, product, order or setting.

productsAdd.title: Add a product
productsAdd.body: A title and a price are enough to start. It can stay a draft until you're ready.

productsImport.title: Or import your catalogue
productsImport.body: Already selling somewhere else? Import a CSV file. A Shopify export works as it is.

storefrontCreate.title: Create a storefront
storefrontCreate.body: A storefront is a grid you design. Each product you place on it gets a page you can share.

storefrontSample.title: See how it's done
storefrontSample.body: This sample shows a finished storefront. Open it to try the designer. Nothing you change there is saved.
storefrontSample.fallbackBody: Open a storefront to design it.

storefrontEmbed.title: Embed a storefront on your site
storefrontEmbed.body: Each storefront has an embed button that gives you a snippet like this one. The widget is still in development and doesn't show on other sites yet.
storefrontEmbed.bodyButton: This button gives you a snippet like the one below to paste into your site. The widget is still in development and doesn't show on other sites yet.
storefrontEmbed.fallbackBody: Once you have a storefront, the embed button on its card gives you a snippet like this one. The widget is still in development and doesn't show on other sites yet.

ordersSearch.title: Find an order
ordersSearch.body: Search by the buyer's email. Orders land here once Square Share checkout opens.

ordersFilters.title: Filter and sort
ordersFilters.body: Narrow orders by channel, status or date, and choose how they're sorted.

analytics.title: See how it's going
analytics.body: Sales and visits to your product pages, over the dates you choose.
analytics.bodyRange: Sales and visits to your product pages, for the dates you pick here.
analytics.bodyFirstRun: Sales and visits to your product pages show up here once one is live.

payments.title: Getting paid
payments.bodyConnect: Connect Stripe here so payouts go straight to your bank.
payments.bodyComingSoon: Getting paid through Stripe is coming soon. Until then, buyers pay you through your product's buy link or by email.

finish.title: Replay the tour any time
finish.body: That's the tour. You can start it again from here whenever you like.

editorAdd.title: Add to your grid
editorAdd.body: Add products, text and shapes from this bar. Drag anything on the grid to move it, and pull a corner to resize it.

editorDesign.title: Set the look
editorDesign.body: Colours, fonts, the header and how product cards look are set once for the whole storefront.
editorDesign.bodyPanel: Colours, fonts, the header and how product cards look are set here, once for the whole storefront.
editorDesign.bodyButton: Tap here for colours, fonts, the header and how product cards look, set once for the whole storefront.

editorPage.title: Every product gets a page
editorPage.body: Each product on the grid has its own page to share. Open one here to see it and style it.

editorFinish.title: Make it yours
editorFinish.body: The sample never saves, so try anything. When you're ready, create a storefront of your own.
